Offline copies of the libraries the pages use (included, so the system works with no internet access):

  bootstrap/        Bootstrap 5.3.3 (CSS and the JavaScript bundle)          MIT licence
  bootstrap-icons/  Bootstrap Icons 1.11.3 (icon font)                         MIT licence
  fonts/            IBM Plex Sans and Barlow Semi Condensed (woff2)            SIL Open Font License 1.1

The system uses these local files automatically. If they are deleted, Bootstrap and the icons are loaded
from cdn.jsdelivr.net instead, and the text falls back to the computer's own fonts.
